cues: Which methyl halide has the largest dipole moment?
Not the fluoride, even though fluorine is the most electronegative.
Chloromethane, one point eight six debye.
The carbon fluorine bond is so short that the charges are close together, and dipole moment is charge times distance.
text: A favourite short question. Which methyl halide has the largest dipole moment? Not the fluoride, even though fluorine is the most electronegative. Chloromethane, one point eight six debye. The carbon fluorine bond is so short that the charges are close together, and dipole moment is charge times distance.
